entries.recommendedTitle: A child rises at His word
entries.alt: Jesus holds the hand of Jairus's daughter as she sits upright, with her parents and three disciples nearby.
entries.caption: The twelve-year-old girl sits upright and meets Jesus's eyes as He holds her hand. Her parents and the three disciples witness the life He restores.
entries.findings: Direct full-pixel comparison with canonical Christ and three-apostle reference: Christ recognizable in profile, clear reciprocal eye contact with girl, natural joyful relief. Girl visibly a child near the stated age rather than a toddler or adult. Exactly seven participants: Christ, girl, parents, Peter at far left, James next, John behind Christ. Apostle face differences preserve mapped references; father older short-gray-haired distinct from apostles. Coherent hand grip and mother's shoulder contact. Natural cloth, skin and daylight; no scars or theatrical glow.
conditions: Depiction shows sitting upright, not completed walking. Exact parents' and child's appearance, room, clothes and arrangement are interpretation. Mark supplies her age as twelve; do not invent other ages.
